function.name: workflow_orchestrator
function.arguments: {"type": "sequential", "steps": [{"tool": "web_search", "args": {"query": "JiDion official YouTube channel"}, "store_result_as": "$results"}, {"tool": "llm_transform", "args": {"prompt": "Extract the URL of JiDion's official YouTube channel.", "context": "$results", "schema": {"url": "string"}}, "store_result_as": "$channel"}, {"tool": "shell_exec", "args": {"command": "curl -sL \"$channel.url\" -o $chika.tmp/jidion_channel.html && echo ok"}, "store_result_as": "$fetch"}, {"tool": "file_read", "args": {"path": "$chika.tmp/jidion_channel.html", "start_line": 1, "end_line": 80}, "store_result_as": "$preview"}, {"tool": "llm_transform", "args": {"prompt": "Extract the URL of JiDion's latest uploaded video from this page snapshot.", "context": "$preview", "schema": {"url": "string"}}, "store_result_as": "$latest"}, {"tool": "app_open", "args": {"target": "$latest.url"}}]}

function.name: workflow_orchestrator
